name: Supplier Invoice -> Simple Accounting Review Queue

parameters.content:
## Setup (no env vars, no n8n credentials - just paste real values into 2 nodes)
1. Create folders: C:\n8n\invoice\inbox and C:\n8n\invoice\queued
2. "Scan Inbox Folder" / "Move File to Queued" use require('fs')/require('path')
   - in n8n's Settings, or via env var, set:
     NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=fs,path
   (self-hosted only; restart n8n after setting)
3. "Gemini - Extract Invoice" node: in the URL field, replace
   YOUR_GEMINI_KEY_HERE with your real Gemini API key
   (aistudio.google.com/apikey).
4. "POST to Review Queue" node: under Header Parameters, replace
   YOUR_SA_API_TOKEN_HERE with your real token from Setup -> API Tokens
   in the app (needs read + purchase:write). Edit the URL host if the app
   isn't on localhost:8080.
5. Drop a real supplier PDF/JPG/PNG into inbox\. The Schedule Trigger polls
   every minute; check Purchases -> Invoice Review in the app afterward.

Note: the key/token sit in plain text in this workflow - fine for a local
dev n8n, but don't share this exported file once filled in.
